usageNotes: Returns the list of available subdirectory endpoints (e.g. 'firewall') under a specific SDN VNet on a node — this is a navigation/index endpoint, not a data endpoint. Use it to discover which sub-resources are accessible for a given VNet before drilling into them. Requires 'SDN.Audit' on '/sdn/zones/<zone>/<vnet>'; the VNet name must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters starting with a letter.

examples.summary: List available sub-resources for SDN VNet 'vnet01' on node 'pve1'

tips: The response is an array of objects with a 'subdir' field (e.g. 'firewall') — use these values to construct further API calls under this VNet.
VNet names are case-sensitive and must match the exact identifier used when the VNet was created in the SDN configuration.
SDN must be configured and applied at the cluster level before VNet sub-resources are reachable via individual nodes.
